visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and a blue-and-white patterned shirt stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway with light-colored wooden doors in the background. He speaks directly to the camera with a neutral but engaging facial expression, gesturing slightly with his head. (2) The scene transitions with a watercolor vignette effect to a living room. A man in a green sweatshirt reclines on a brown leather sofa. An older man in a green bomber jacket and an older woman in a black shirt attend to him; the man feeds him fruit with a fork while the woman fans him. (3) The man in the green sweatshirt remains on the couch looking at a smartphone. An older man enters through a sliding glass door, wearing a crossbody bag. They interact near a space heater; the older man takes out cash and hands it to the younger man. (4) In the same room, an older woman with glasses sits at a low wooden table writing on paper. The man in the green sweatshirt lies on the couch behind her, pointing at her work and appearing to give instructions with a demanding expression. (5) The video cuts back to the man in the blue patterned shirt. He is now holding a large, square red gift box with gold circular patterns and Chinese text. He presents it to the older man and woman, who are now standing in the living room. (6) Close-up shots feature the gift box's contents: five small glass jars with gold lids labeled with the brand name, and a packaged piece of dried bird's nest. The background is a white table surface with decorative seashells. (7) A close-up shows hands peeling a green foil lid off a jar, revealing a clear, thick gelatinous substance. The substance is then poured from a gold-rimmed bowl into a white ceramic tureen with floral patterns. (8) The older man and woman are shown in individual close-up shots. The man eats from a spoon with a satisfied smile, and the woman drinks directly from a small jar, looking refreshed and pleased. (9) The man and the older couple sit together on the sofa, each holding a jar of bird's nest. They smile and toast toward the camera. Large text overlays and a promotional list with prices appear over the frame.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'childhood fantasy' role-reversal hook—where the son is pampered by the parents—to contrast with the reality of filial piety during the Lunar New Year. It transitions into a product showcase for Eu Yan Sang bird's nest gift sets, demonstrating their quality and the parents' satisfaction to encourage holiday gifting and purchase.
